usage: danbooru_gallery_dl.py [-h] [--root ROOT]
                              [--gallery-dl-dir GALLERY_DL_DIR]
                              [--sidecar-dir SIDECAR_DIR] [--user-db USER_DB]
                              {download,backfill,import-discover,import-enrich,index,sqlite,sync,import-finalize,clean-sidecars,search}
                              ...

Download Danbooru files with gallery-dl sidecars, or backfill metadata for
existing local media by Danbooru MD5 lookup.

positional arguments:
  {download,backfill,import-discover,import-enrich,index,sqlite,sync,import-finalize,clean-sidecars,search}
    download            Use gallery-dl to download a Danbooru tag search with
                        JSON and tag sidecars.
    backfill            Write sidecar tags/metadata for existing local media
                        by querying Danbooru.
    import-discover     Import phase 1: discover paths using directory
                        metadata only.
    import-enrich       Import phase 2: hash files and read dimensions with
                        bounded workers.
    index               Build one central JSON search index from existing
                        .danbooru.json sidecars.
    sqlite              Build a searchable SQLite database from existing
                        .danbooru.json sidecars.
    sync                Incrementally sync media folders into the SQLite
                        database: import new/changed sidecars, index sidecar-
                        less media, remove rows for deleted files. No rebuild.
    import-finalize     Import phase 4: incrementally sync sidecars and
                        finalize the import ledger.
    clean-sidecars      Delete .danbooru.json and .tags.txt sidecars whose
                        original media file is missing.
    search              Search the SQLite database by Danbooru tags and simple
                        filters.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           Workspace root. Default: project root.
  --gallery-dl-dir GALLERY_DL_DIR
                        gallery-dl config/archive work folder. Relative paths
                        use the project root.
  --sidecar-dir SIDECAR_DIR
                        Central sidecar folder. Relative paths use the project
                        root.
  --user-db USER_DB     User database containing stable registered-root
                        identities.

usage: danbooru_gallery_dl.py download [-h] [--folder FOLDER]
                                       [--tag-folder TAG_FOLDER]
                                       [--destination DESTINATION]
                                       [--filename FILENAME] [--limit LIMIT]
                                       [--archive ARCHIVE]
                                       [--sleep-request SLEEP_REQUEST]
                                       [--sleep-429 SLEEP_429]
                                       [--retries RETRIES]
                                       [--metadata-includes METADATA_INCLUDES]
                                       [--username USERNAME]
                                       [--api-key API_KEY] [--ugoira-zip]
                                       [--external] [--dry-run]
                                       tags [tags ...]

positional arguments:
  tags                  Danbooru tag query, e.g. 1girl rating:safe

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --folder FOLDER       Top-level output folder.
  --tag-folder TAG_FOLDER
                        Output subfolder. Default: sanitized tag query.
  --destination DESTINATION
                        Exact output directory (used by the in-app
                        downloader).
  --filename FILENAME   gallery-dl filename format.
  --limit LIMIT         Limit downloads with gallery-dl --range 1-N.
  --archive ARCHIVE     gallery-dl archive sqlite path.
  --sleep-request SLEEP_REQUEST
                        gallery-dl request delay.
  --sleep-429 SLEEP_429
                        gallery-dl 429 retry delay.
  --retries RETRIES
  --metadata-includes METADATA_INCLUDES
                        Comma-separated Danbooru extra metadata includes.
  --username USERNAME   Danbooru username, or set DANBOORU_USERNAME.
  --api-key API_KEY     Danbooru API key, or set DANBOORU_API_KEY.
  --ugoira-zip          Download ugoira ZIPs instead of converted videos.
  --external            Follow source URLs for restricted/unavailable posts.
  --dry-run             Print config and command without running gallery-dl.

usage: danbooru_gallery_dl.py backfill [-h] [--limit LIMIT] [--delay DELAY]
                                       [--retries RETRIES]
                                       [--json-suffix JSON_SUFFIX]
                                       [--tags-suffix TAGS_SUFFIX]
                                       [--overwrite]
                                       [--archive-replaced-sidecars]
                                       [--sidecar-archive-dir SIDECAR_ARCHIVE_DIR]
                                       [--filename-md5-only]
                                       [--gallery-dl-names-only]
                                       [--index-jsonl INDEX_JSONL]
                                       [--append-index] [--extra-metadata]
                                       [--metadata-includes METADATA_INCLUDES]
                                       [--username USERNAME]
                                       [--api-key API_KEY] [--dry-run]
                                       [--use-indexed-md5]
                                       [--database DATABASE]
                                       [paths ...]

positional arguments:
  paths                 Files/folders to scan. Defaults to Danbooru folders.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --limit LIMIT         Only process the first N media files.
  --delay DELAY         Seconds to wait between Danbooru API requests.
  --retries RETRIES
  --json-suffix JSON_SUFFIX
  --tags-suffix TAGS_SUFFIX
  --overwrite           Rewrite existing sidecars.
  --archive-replaced-sidecars
                        Copy existing sidecars to the sidecar archive before
                        overwriting them.
  --sidecar-archive-dir SIDECAR_ARCHIVE_DIR
                        Archive folder for replaced sidecars. Default: project
                        data/sidecar_archive/<timestamp>.
  --filename-md5-only   Only inspect files with a 32-character hex hash in the
                        filename.
  --gallery-dl-names-only
                        Only inspect gallery-dl-style filenames beginning with
                        double underscores.
  --index-jsonl INDEX_JSONL
                        Also write matched metadata to one newline-delimited
                        JSON index file.
  --append-index        Append to --index-jsonl instead of replacing it at the
                        start of the run.
  --extra-metadata      Fetch notes/commentary/parent/children/uploader.
  --metadata-includes METADATA_INCLUDES
                        Comma-separated Danbooru extra metadata includes.
  --username USERNAME   Danbooru username, or set DANBOORU_USERNAME.
  --api-key API_KEY     Danbooru API key, or set DANBOORU_API_KEY.
  --dry-run             List files that would be inspected.
  --use-indexed-md5     Reuse local_md5 from the SQLite index instead of
                        hashing media again.
  --database DATABASE   SQLite index used by --use-indexed-md5.

positional arguments:

options:

  --output OUTPUT
  --workers WORKERS

usage: danbooru_gallery_dl.py index [-h] [--output OUTPUT]
                                    [--json-suffix JSON_SUFFIX]
                                    [--limit LIMIT] [--pretty] [--full]
                                    [paths ...]

positional arguments:
  paths                 Folders to scan. Defaults to Danbooru folders.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --output OUTPUT       Central JSON index to write.
  --json-suffix JSON_SUFFIX
  --limit LIMIT         Only index the first N sidecars.
  --pretty              Write indented JSON. Larger but easier to inspect.
  --full                Store full per-file payloads instead of compact
                        records.

usage: danbooru_gallery_dl.py sqlite [-h] [--output OUTPUT]
                                     [--json-suffix JSON_SUFFIX]
                                     [--limit LIMIT] [--replace]
                                     [--commit-every COMMIT_EVERY]
                                     [--include-missing-media] [--no-raw-json]
                                     [--extra-root EXTRA_ROOT]
                                     [paths ...]

positional arguments:
  paths                 Folders to scan. Defaults to Danbooru folders.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --output OUTPUT       SQLite database to write.
  --json-suffix JSON_SUFFIX
  --limit LIMIT         Only import the first N sidecars.
  --replace             Delete and rebuild the database before importing.
  --commit-every COMMIT_EVERY
                        Commit after every N imported sidecars. Use 0 to
                        commit once at the end.
  --include-missing-media
                        Import sidecars even when their referenced media file
                        is missing.
  --no-raw-json         Do not store the full sidecar payload in the raw_json
                        column.
  --extra-root EXTRA_ROOT
                        Registered external media folder; its files get the
                        folder's name as their folder label. Repeatable.

usage: danbooru_gallery_dl.py sync [-h] [--output OUTPUT]
                                   [--json-suffix JSON_SUFFIX] [--no-raw-json]
                                   [paths ...]

positional arguments:
  paths                 Media folders to sync. Defaults to Danbooru folders.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --output OUTPUT       SQLite database to update.
  --json-suffix JSON_SUFFIX
  --no-raw-json         Do not store the full sidecar payload in the raw_json
                        column.

usage: danbooru_gallery_dl.py import-finalize [-h] [--output OUTPUT]
                                              [--json-suffix JSON_SUFFIX]
                                              [--no-raw-json]
                                              [paths ...]

positional arguments:
  paths

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --output OUTPUT

usage: danbooru_gallery_dl.py clean-sidecars [-h] [--json-suffix JSON_SUFFIX]
                                             [--tags-suffix TAGS_SUFFIX]
                                             [--limit LIMIT] [--dry-run]
                                             [paths ...]

positional arguments:
  paths                 Folders to scan. Defaults to Danbooru folders.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --json-suffix JSON_SUFFIX
  --tags-suffix TAGS_SUFFIX
  --limit LIMIT         Only inspect/delete the first N orphan sidecars.
  --dry-run             Print sidecars that would be deleted without deleting
                        them.

usage: danbooru_gallery_dl.py search [-h] [--database DATABASE]
                                     [--limit LIMIT] [--json]
                                     ...

positional arguments:
  terms                Tags/filters. Examples: 2b_(nier:automata) solo
                       rating:s ext:jpg artist:atomicmrshmallw -chibi
                       2160x3840 dim:>=1920x1080 orientation:portrait

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --database DATABASE  SQLite database to search.
  --limit LIMIT
  --json               Print search results as JSON.
